title: The Cybertruck's "unbreakable" window
caption:
They threw one ball at the armour glass on live TV. The glass did not win. 🛻
Toughened glass is strong, but once it's cracked, a crack can race through it at hundreds of metres per second.
Would you have thrown it a second time?
sources: Tesla Cybertruck unveiling, 21 November 2019 (live stage demo: front and rear windows cracked by a thrown metal ball; Musk: "Well, it didn't go through")
Elon Musk on Twitter, 23 November 2019: a sledgehammer hit before the ball test cracked the base of the glass
